fills.found:
### Step 1 (scout)
Mosquitto: about 1 MB at rest (mosquitto.org/man); TLS through listener options; persistence to a file.
EMQX: no memory figure found in the docs; the docs list TLS on listener 8883 and a built-in database.
NanoMQ: about 2 MB at rest (nanomq.io docs); TLS through its conf; persistence through SQLite.
Open: EMQX's memory at rest was not found in its documentation.
